parsed.explanation: Combined regime: national binary passport and entry-discrepancy rule create universal document exposure, with refusal and, if wilful misrepresentation is found, possible permanent fraud ineligibility after a non-automatic four-element finding. Federal facilities are barred by birth sex, and national custody reports document conversion-therapy practices, forced labour, beatings, solitary and sexual abuse. This state currently imposes no restroom restriction, has a 2019 hate-crime enhancement, and operates within functioning courts that have enjoined several national orders, which mitigates but does not cancel the entry, facility and custody exposures.

entry_documents.exposure: National passports issued only M/F per supporting documents; X not newly issued though existing X passports remain valid. 2025 cable: document/record discrepancy or doubt about sex mandates refusal and more evidence; suspected wilful misrepresentation may support permanent lifetime fraud ineligibility. Passports reported confiscated/blocked.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiration; fraud finding requires four elements, limited waivers, never automatic; ACLU suit and court challenges pending; legal-aid FAQ exists.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport mismatch at entry can trigger refusal, investigation, detention and birth-sex custody placement; state driver-licence marker ban does not govern visitor passports but signals document hostility.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections bureau from 2026 adopted conversion-therapy model: short haircuts, hormone removal, psychiatric therapy/drugs; reporting of trans prisoners stopped 2025. Immigration custody: trans men reported forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Rescinded earlier prison LGBTQ order is documented, not a protection. No documented visitor-specific custody safeguard; several national orders have been enjoined generally.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry fraud allegation or any arrest can lead to detention where documented abuse and birth-sex placement risks materialise; oversight does not document remedy for these practices.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National executive order bars trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. Many states ban facility use, but this state is not listed among them; national map notes other sex-definition policies may still affect access.
federal_state_facilities.protection: As of April 2026 this state's law places no restriction on restroom use matching gender identity; two cities protect it by ordinance; 2023 injunction protected a student's bathroom use; 2026 school/university bill passed Senate 37-8 but received no lower-chamber hearing and is not law.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal buildings and nationally funded facilities remain restricted even where state restrooms are unrestricted; pending state bill would, if enacted, impose birth-sex facilities in public schools/universities and prisons.

care_services.exposure: State 2023 law, upheld Nov 2024, bans transition surgery, blockers and hormones for under-18s, phase-out only; a trans visitor under 18 cannot obtain that care here. National orders target minor care and funding.
care_services.protection: No documented adult care ban in this state; adult availability is not_documented. Emergency care access not documented.
care_services.interaction: Parent/guardian travelling with a minor faces care denial for the minor, while adult care continuity may be disrupted by federal facility/document rules and hormone removal if detained.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National executive order legally defines sex as binary at birth, rescinds pronoun/name policies, bans trans athletes; DOJ memo uses 'radical gender ideology' as extremist viewpoint, May 2026 counterterrorism strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' violent groups, though ideology alone is not a reward criterion.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Several orders blocked/enjoined; 2020 Supreme Court employment ruling and national hate-crime statute remain; state 2019 law adds sentencing enhancement for gender-identity bias.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat framing raises police/entry discretion risk and social hostility, while court injunctions and hate-crime enhancement provide partial, uneven recourse; 66% poll support for birth-sex document laws indicates majority backing for restrictions.

minors_guardians.exposure: Minor transition care banned in state and increasingly nationally; 2023 law requires schools notify parents if minor asks for different name/pronouns; national order directs investigation/prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition; 2023 birth-certificate cases left trial courts without authority to amend, used to restrict a 9-year-old's bathroom access.
minors_guardians.protection: Current state law imposes no restroom restriction; a federal appellate injunction barred school bathroom limits in 2023 litigation; Senate facility bill is not law.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling minor faces care denial and school facility uncertainty; guardian may face disclosure via school notification rules and national investigations, even though general restroom use is currently unrestricted.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Not documented. No trans-specific visitor violence, police targeting, extortion or app-entrapment pattern is described for this state. National custody abuse is documented separately.
street_violence_police_response.protection: State hate-crime enhancement since 2019; national hate-crime coverage. Enforcement frequency for gender-identity bias is not documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: If assault occurs, enhancement exists on paper, but absence of enforcement data means street-level police response for visitors is uncertain, not proven protective.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport ACLU suit, challenges to executive orders and state licence-ban challenge are unresolved; outcomes unknown. Custody bureau stopped reporting trans prisoner numbers from 2025.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Functioning courts have enjoined several national orders; legal-aid FAQ; hate-crime enhancement; city ordinances protecting restroom use.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies are prospective and litigated, not guaranteed at travel time; a visitor refused entry, denied a facility or detained may have no timely in-country remedy before departure.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar universal document checks, passport confiscation/blocking and prolonged questioning, but unlike 0.35-B courts here actively enjoin orders and fraud ineligibility is non-automatic with waivers, so severity is somewhat lower than routine police shakedowns with deferential courts.

Higher risk than 0.55-B: that anchor is mainly secondary screening and discretionary refusal with appeal desk. Here refusal can escalate to permanent lifetime fraud ineligibility and documented custody abuse, plus federal facility exclusion, making consequences materially worse.

Lower than 0.65-A: there, brief detention ended in release, apology and compensation under explicit national equality protection. Here the binary passport rule was allowed by the Supreme Court, federal facilities are restricted by policy, and no documented compensation/remedy for entry or custody harms exists.

parsed.synthesis: The operative interaction is document mismatch at entry or in federal facilities -> refusal/investigation -> possible detention with birth-sex custody and documented abuse, for adults and for minors denied transition care. State-level restroom freedom, city ordinances, hate-crime enhancement and active litigation are real mitigations, but they do not pre-empt federal entry, facility or custody rules. No execution or routine imprisonment for being trans is documented, keeping the score above 0.15-0.25, while universal binary-document exposure and severe custody findings keep it below the 0.55-0.65 administrative-friction anchors.
